entries.zh: 火烟；烟（燃烧所生之烟）
entries.en: smoke; fumes of fire

entries.zh: 火烟熏气；烟熏火燎之气
entries.en: fumes of fire; smoke fumes

entries.zh: 熏烟；烟熏之气
entries.en: smoke; fumes (of smoke)

entries.zh: 烟气下沉；低垂之烟（义项存疑）
entries.en: descending/heavy smoke; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语栏“humos depression.”非习见搭配，汉栏奮/奪存疑，暂据字面定为烟气下沉义。

entries.zh: 陷落；下陷
entries.en: to sink; to cave in, fall in

entries.zh: 下陷；凹陷〔原稿残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to sink; hollow, sunken place (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语栏 utonlabe/utarlabe 两读难辨，闽南语栏标[残]逐词难辨，仅据 L 栏 hundirse 与汉字“凹”定下陷义。

entries.zh: 沉；沉入水中
entries.en: to sink (in the water); to submerge

entries.zh: 崩塌；房屋土地崩陷（崩落、崩陷）
entries.en: to collapse, fall down (of a house or land); to cave in

entries.zh: 陷入泥中；泥泞下陷
entries.en: to sink into mud; to mire
entries.notes: 闽南语栏音调标记 T99 污损难辨；字义据 L 栏 en el lodo 与汉字“凹”定为陷泥义。

entries.zh: 船沉落水；两船相撞俱沉
entries.en: (of ships) to sink by running into each other; to sink into the water
entries.notes: 闽南语栏首音节 T99 污损；据 L 栏 dos navios topándose（两船相撞）及音写“沉落水”定相撞沉没义。

entries.zh: 凹陷之物〔西语尾词与汉栏字形难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: a sunken/depressed thing; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语尾词 utnaricesx 难解，汉栏躡/躍存疑，闽南语栏有 T99 污损；仅据 hundida cosa 定凹陷物义。

entries.zh: 地陷；土地崩陷
entries.en: the land to sink, to collapse
entries.notes: 闽南语栏音调标记 T99 污损；L 栏 hundirse la tierra 与汉字“崩陷”互证为地陷义。

entries.zh: 头骨塌陷；骨髓凹陷（骨裂内陷）
entries.en: the skull to cave in; bone and marrow depressed

entries.zh: 踏凹；脚踩下陷（踩出凹痕）
entries.en: the foot to sink in; to tread into a hollow

entries.zh: 船沉没；沉溺（沉入水中）
entries.en: the ship to sink; to founder, go under

entries.zh: 船沉没（胶流水：水卷缠而卷沉）
entries.en: the ship to sink, dragged/whirled under by the current

entries.zh: 船翻覆沉没、底朝天（汉栏末字存疑）
entries.en: the ship to sink, turning keel-up (belly up); sense partly uncertain
entries.notes: 汉栏末字喪/縛存疑且闽南语栏有 T99 污损；据 L 栏 bolverse boca abajo（翻底朝天）与音写 pak（腹）定翻覆义。

entries.zh: 凹落去；下陷下去（软物受压塌陷，泛指物陷落）
entries.en: to sink down, give way (soft ground yielding); anything to sink in
entries.notes: 闽南语栏首音节 T99 污损，L 栏 como el cedero lo blando 拼写存疑；据 o hundirse cualquier cosa 与汉字“凹落去”定泛指陷落义。

entries.zh: 抢夺；劫掠（偷抢）
entries.en: to rob, snatch; to steal
entries.notes: 汉栏損/搶存疑、闽南语栏两处 T99 污损；西语 Hurtar ~ arrubatar（偷～抢夺）与音写 chiang 指向“搶”义。

entries.zh: 偷；偷窃〔汉栏“極”疑为误写，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to steal
entries.notes: 汉栏“極”与 hurtar（偷）义不协、闽南语栏首音节 T99 污损；据 L 栏及音写 tau 定“偷”义。
